content:
Hey all, keeping this one quick as by its premise there is no point to say much. There are hello posts, surprised never saw a goodbye, seems thematically fitting. I guess it must be simple because no one leaves this warm and welcoming community!

Thanks to those were kind to me at any stage, you know who you are, even if its just a single reply. You know where to reach me. Mods etc feel free to deactivate.

No one reads what I say anyway, not even to react positively or negatively, which ultimately is a hint even my autism can take. Obviously do not take this as some welfare thing, not that it will cause anything but celebration, its just from here.

Adios!
